title: Highview, Harker Heights, TX
description: While close to the city, this 10 acre residential tract feels like miles from nowhere. On Highview on the right side just before you enter Colinas Del Lago, this tract runs almost level for several hundred feet before falling off sharply at the cliff over the lake. Clear some brush and trees out of the way and you'll have a stunning view for miles. The size of the property allows for a deep setback from the road and distance to each side for total privacy. No survey on file so a new one will need to be ordered. Drone footage will be added shortly to the listing to highlight the location, view, and gorgeous setting. Location being important to a high-end home, this one is worth checking out while getting your custom plans together.
